fact: In report-tool implementation and performance turns, a tool receipt binds a nonempty output excerpt to the same clean Git revision observed before and after the tool call.

On the legacy report-driven path, a passing experiment implementation advances to performance. When review requests another measurement, the run enters performance if it has not yet been measured, or becomes blocked if it has.
For the legacy review path, the review-input digest includes the review phase, candidate revision, project fact snapshot head, plan version, changes, synchronization candidates and review evidence.
